text: Aisha Silim, Manager, Renters Strategy Unit, Housing Secretariat, and senior City staff will provide a presentation on the City’s Multi-Tenant Homes Framework and overview supports for tenants.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Requested that City staff supporting the implementation of the Multi-Tenant Homes Framework include in their report back to City Council in Fall 2025 an assessment of opportunities and considerations for collecting disaggregated data on vulnerable tenants in multi-tenant housing, in order to better identify priority populations that may be disproportionately impacted by housing instability to inform planning to ensure that adequate and appropriate services are available to support them.
